schema.title: Invocation manifest for fMRIPREP: A Robust Preprocessing Pipeline for fMRI Data

description:
Subject: fMRIPrep Run Configuration – Details and Inputs  

Hi Team,  

For the upcoming preprocessing batch I’ve set up the fMRIPrep parameters as follows: we will **not** retain the final output files in the main directory (save_outputs = false) but we will keep all intermediate products, storing them under **temp/intermediate** and organizing the related folders in **temp/folders**. The FreeSurfer processing is enabled (freesurfer = true), and we have opted to preserve the intermediate work (save_intermediate_work = true). The required license information is provided – the reference tag is **FREESURFER_LICENSE**, linked to the email **user@example.com**, with license number **12345678** and license key **ABCDEF1234567890**.  

All input assets are ready: the API key has been supplied (details are encapsulated within the request), and both the T1‑weighted and T2‑weighted anatomical scans (t1w_anatomy and t2w_anatomy) are present in the input bundle. Let me know if anything needs adjustment before we kick off the pipeline.
